questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.answer: I always wanted to go to australia and at this university there was the possibility of having indigenous studies.

questions.answer: very easy! They where also quick to answer my emails before my arrival

questions.answer: They did a couple of introduction lectures on the country, the city, the university. It gave me all the information i needed.

questions.answer: Easy for me because I found it early 4 months early. however others struggled.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: StudentOne is a great place! it is expensive, but worth all the money. I got all my friends from there and you a lot for your money.
